violation_type.title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included (26 TAC §744.1507(4))
violation_type.short_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed supervising 38 children at the restrooms bringing the group out of ratio by 13. This was corrected when the second caregiver joined the group.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed supervising 38 children at the restrooms bringing the group out of ratio by 13. This was corrected when the second caregiver joined the group.

Caregivers were observed supervising 42 children. One caregiver took 10 children to the restroom, leaving the other caregiver with 32 children, bringing the group out of ratio by 7.   Each time a parent came to sign a child out, a caregiver was observed leaving the group of children with one caregiver to go open the door for the parent.
